component.name: Plasma Shortcut Explorer
component.summary: Search your configured KDE global shortcuts

description.p: Explore the keyboard shortcuts registered with KDE Plasma. Search actions, applications, categories, and key combinations using a compact keyboard-first overlay.
Plasma Shortcut Explorer reads your current configuration without changing bindings. It requires a running KDE Plasma 6 session and its KGlobalAccel service.
Bound shortcut discovery and improve test isolation and uninstall safety.
Initial shortcut discovery and searchable overlay.
